865a68.title: False Positive: Insecure HTTP Request for License Scan (vuln-0002)
865a68.content: Upon manual inspection of `backend/main.py`, the `scan_license` endpoint does not make an insecure HTTP request to `http://api.example.com/license-scan`. The code directly calls the Gemini API over HTTPS. The SAST finding `vuln-0002` is a false positive for the current codebase.
